definitions.explanation: A smooth, reflective shine on a surface. Used for materials like fabric, hair, metal, paper, and finished products.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{光沢|こうたく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: This leather develops a beautiful luster when polished.

notes:
USAGE:
{光沢|こうたく} refers to a reflective quality on surfaces and is commonly used in product descriptions, material science, and everyday descriptions of polished or glossy items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {光沢|こうたく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (have a sheen)
- {光沢|こうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (bring out a sheen)
- {光沢|こうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びる→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧ (take on a luster)
- {光沢|こうたく}⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧ (glossy finish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{艶|つや}→艶：03893_tsuya⟧ is a more everyday word for gloss or sheen, often used for hair and skin
- {光沢|こうたく} is more technical and formal, common in product descriptions and material contexts
